privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey must be titled exactly 'Service Quality Gap Analysis - SERVQUAL 2024'. The Array (Dual Scale) question (Code: SQ001) must have 5 sub-questions: Tangibles, Reliability, Responsiveness, Assurance, and Empathy. Scale 1 must range from 1 (Not at all Important) to 5 (Extremely Important). Scale 2 must range from 1 (Very Poor) to 5 (Excellent). The feedback question must use code 'FEEDBACK'. The survey must be set to 'Anonymized responses: Yes' and be fully activated.
